# routeros_ip_media_settings (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_media_settings" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `thumbnails` (String) Comma separated list of filenames (should end with .jpg). If name of a file in a directory matches any filename in the list, that file is treated as a thumbnail to any media file in that directory.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_ip_media_settings.settings .
```
